newsitem.title: BULGARIA: NO DEALS ON BULGARIA STOCK MARKET, RABSI UNCHANGED.
newsitem.headline: NO DEALS ON BULGARIA STOCK MARKET, RABSI UNCHANGED.

text.p: The RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Friday at 41.31 points as there were no deals in corporate paper on local bourses, brokers said.

Central Cooperative Bank's shares were offered at the par of 1,000 levs on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE) but there no bidders. Biohim shares were also offered there at 650 levs, below the par of 1 000 but no bids were received.
Varna Grand Hotel stocks were bid at 82 levs on the BSE but no one offered, traders said.
There were no offers for corporate stocks on the Sofia Stock Exchange and no repo deals in treasury paper either.
RABSI has been calculated on a daily basis since February 1994. -- Rumen Sokolov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
